DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL to the sibling 'postgres' service (postgres:16-alpine). Literal credentials match the defaults in postgres/template-vars.json so marketplace first-time deploys authenticate out of the box.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL to the sibling 'redis' service. Literal credentials match the defaults in redis/template-vars.json so marketplace first-time deploys authenticate out of the box.

BUZZ_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint for media storage. Points to the sibling 'minio' service.

BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 access key. Matches the default in minio/template-vars.json.

BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY.description: S3 secret key. Matches the default in minio/template-vars.json.

BUZZ_S3_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name for media storage.

RELAY_OWNER_PUBKEY.description: Optional: Nostr public key (hex) that owns this relay. If empty, the relay runs in open mode.

BUZZ_RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Nostr private key (hex) for the relay. Auto-generated if not provided.

BUZZ_GIT_HOOK_HMAC_SECRET.description: HMAC secret for git hook verification. Auto-generated.

BUZZ_AUTO_MIGRATE.description: Automatically run database migrations on startup.

BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE.description: Enable git conformance probe on startup.
